name: 4HB4 the End of the Road
source:
"Have you seen the news? A meteor's gonna hit Earth in four hours! Then why are you just sitting here?! Hop in the car and go on a road trip with me!"

[From [url=https://hi-hamguin.itch.io/4hb4-the-end-of-the-road]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你看新闻了吗？四小时后就要有陨石撞地球了！那你还在这儿傻坐着干嘛？！快上车，陪我去兜一趟公路旅行吧！”

[摘自[url=https://hi-hamguin.itch.io/4hb4-the-end-of-the-road]itch.io[/url]]
